description: This Java source file defines the class InsertWithUuidDataChange, which extends the InsertDataChange class. It customizes the insert data operation to generate and insert a UUID into a specified column if not already provided.

classes.name: InsertWithUuidDataChange
classes.description: A custom Liquibase change class that extends InsertDataChange to automatically generate and insert a UUID into the insert statement if the UUID column is not specified.

methods.name: generateStatements
methods.description: Overrides the method to add a UUID value to the insert statement if the UUID column is not already specified.
